rules.description: Only registered and verified students may apply for scholarships.
rules.condition: When a student attempts to apply for a scholarship.
rules.outcome: The application is permitted only if the student is both registered and verified.
rules.evidence_quote: Only registered and verified students will be allowed to apply for scholarships.

rules.description: A student may apply for only one scholarship scheme from the displayed eligible list.
rules.outcome: The student must select a single scheme from the presented eligible schemes.
rules.evidence_quote: A student will, however, be allowed to apply for one scheme only from the displayed list of eligible schemes.

rules.description: The portal allows applicants to save their scholarship application before final submission.
rules.condition: Before the applicant submits the application.
rules.outcome: The applicant can save the partially completed application.
rules.evidence_quote: The Portal will incorporate a provision to save the application before making final submission.

rules.description: Applicants can modify saved application details multiple times before final submission.
rules.condition: While the application remains in saved (not submitted) status.
rules.evidence_quote: The student will be allowed to make multiple changes in the saved details, before final submission.

rules.description: No changes are allowed to the application after it has been submitted.
rules.condition: After the applicant has submitted the scholarship application.
rules.outcome: The application becomes locked; no edits, including scheme changes, are permitted.
rules.evidence_quote: However, after submission, the student will not be allowed to make any change(s) in his/her application, including change in opted scholarship scheme.

rules.description: In exceptional circumstances, personal details (except Aadhaar Number) may be changed after verification by a District Authority or higher.
rules.condition: When an exceptional circumstance is identified and verification is performed by an authority registered on NSP at District level or above.
rules.outcome: The student may update personal details, but Aadhaar Number cannot be changed.
rules.evidence_quote: The students may, however, be allowed to change their personal details except Aadhaar Number at a later stage, in exceptional circumstances, after due verification of authenticity of claim by an authority registered on NSP, not below the level of District Authority.
